subject: Returning patient — routine mental health check-in form
body: I've been having thoughts about not wanting to be here. I've been feeling like things will never get better. I've had these kinds of thoughts for a long time — they're just part of how I've always felt. I've been feeling pretty low and disconnected from everything around me. I haven't been sleeping well — I usually have trouble sleeping. I've been eating less than I should, but I've been like that for a while. I don't spend much time with other people; I've always been more of a loner. I'm filling this out because the clinic sends this form every three months.
